title: ORCHID: Orchestrated Retrieval-Augmented Classification with Human-in-the-Loop Intelligent Decision-Making for High-Risk Property
authors: Maria Mahbub; Vanessa Lama; Sanjay Das; Brian Starks; Christopher Polchek; Saffell Silvers; Lauren Deck; Prasanna Balaprakash; Tirthankar Ghosal
why_relevant: ORCHID is a domain-specific RAG application for DOE high-risk property classification with human-in-the-loop deferral and a validator handling conflicts, but it does not contribute methods or analysis on robustness, calibration, or unreliable evidence beyond a system demo.
why_not_or_caveat: Application/demo paper without robustness evaluation or novel techniques for the survey's themes.
